$comment: Native toolchain versions. Single source of truth, read by flake.nix
(builtins.fromJSON), by CI, by 'just doctor', and by the deps-new
template generator, which stamps these values into a generated
workspace's flake.nix so it cannot drift from the mono release it pins.
JSON rather than EDN because nix can only parse JSON natively.
Changing a version means changing its sha256 in the same edit:
Cross-check against the vendor's published checksum where one exists;
FoundationDB publishes a .sha256 asset beside each package.
Rationale for the FoundationDB pin lives in flake.nix, next to the
derivation whose unpack step depends on it.
